diff --git a/mail/Makefile.in b/mail/Makefile.in
index d5adbb1facf..02b45340d8c 100644
--- a/mail/Makefile.in
+++ b/mail/Makefile.in
@@ -25,9 +25,7 @@ libs:: $(DIST)/bin/platform.ini
 
 
 vendored-rust-check:
-ifdef MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST
 	@echo "Checking vendored Rust libs"
 	$(PYTHON3) $(commtopsrcdir)/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py verify_vendored_dependencies
-endif
 
 export:: vendored-rust-check
diff --git a/mail/moz.build b/mail/moz.build
index 27e61b86c56..61e69278542 100644
--- a/mail/moz.build
+++ b/mail/moz.build
@@ -31,9 +31,6 @@ if CONFIG["MOZ_BUNDLED_FONTS"]:
 if CONFIG["MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC"]:
     DIRS += ["services/sync"]
 
-if CONFIG["MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST"]:
-    DEFINES["MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST"] = 1
-
 DIRS += [
     "../python",
     "../taskcluster",
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index e587a57697c..b72e87b8ab4 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -192,9 +192,7 @@ def thunderbird_official_branding_directory(thunderbird_official_branding):
 #    reason=thunderbird_official_branding,
 # )
 
-# Thunderbird Rust code is now the only way to compile
-set_config("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST", True)
-set_define("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST", True)
+# Override Firefox's Cargo workspace with our own.
 set_config("MOZ_OVERRIDE_GKRUST", True)
 set_config(
     "MOZ_OVERRIDE_CARGO_CONFIG",
diff --git a/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp b/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp
index df5994e5cfe..5a25b260be6 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/base/src/nsNewMailnewsURI.cpp
@@ -126,13 +126,11 @@ nsresult NS_NewMailnewsURI(nsIURI** aURI, const nsACString& aSpec,
         .SetSpec(aSpec)
         .Finalize(aURI);
   }
-#if defined(MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST)
   if (scheme.EqualsLiteral("ews") || scheme.EqualsLiteral("ews-message")) {
     return NS_MutateURI(new mozilla::net::nsStandardURL::Mutator())
         .SetSpec(aSpec)
         .Finalize(aURI);
   }
-#endif
 
   rv = NS_ERROR_UNKNOWN_PROTOCOL;  // Let M-C handle it by default.

index 23b11795d7f..3aebc10c48d 100644
--- a/mailnews/mailnews.js
+++ b/mailnews/mailnews.js
@@ -1129,10 +1129,8 @@ pref("mail.export.loglevel", "Warn");
 // memory cache is used instead. Both use the cache2 implementation.
 pref("mail.imap.use_disk_cache2", true);
 
-#ifdef MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST
 // Enable support for Microsoft Exchange via Exchange Web Services.
 pref("experimental.mail.ews.enabled", true);
-#endif
 
 // Enable users to override OAuth provider details for EWS accounts.
 pref("experimental.mail.ews.overrideOAuth.enabled", false);
